findings.description: PFL-MARRIAGE-01 missed. Document explicitly shows 'Civil Registration Status: unregistered', 'Marital Status: single', and a page-2 notice 'Spousal status remains legally single under civil jurisdiction'. Worker returned only the generic requirement rule and flagged no defect.

PFL-MARRIAGE-01 missed (scanned sibling). Unregistered religious ceremony with marital status 'single' and explicit non-registration notice went unflagged; Worker gave boilerplate requirement text only.
PFL-MARRIAGE-02 missed. Narrative states certificate name 'Sora Takahashi' vs passport 'Sora Kim' without legal name-change documentation. Worker did not detect the identity mismatch.
PFL-MARRIAGE-02 missed (scanned sibling). Explicit Takahashi/Kim name discrepancy in narrative unflagged; Worker returned generic rule only.

PFL-MARRIAGE-03 missed. Document shows 'Physical Presence: False', location 'Virtual Videoconference', and narrative confirming proxy/virtual solemnization with no physical presence — a marriage IRCC does not recognize. Worker flagged nothing.
PFL-MARRIAGE-03 missed (scanned sibling). Proxy/virtual marriage (physical presence false, tele-marriage registrar) unflagged; Worker produced generic requirement text.

PFL-MARRIAGE-04 missed. Document Translation field states 'Informal machine translation without translator affidavit, certification stamp, or credentials' and narrative confirms uncertified web translation. Worker did not flag the translation deficiency.
PFL-MARRIAGE-04 missed (scanned sibling). Spanish certificate with uncertified machine translation lacking translator affidavit unflagged; Worker gave generic rule only.

Systemic behavior: Worker answered the generic 'what document is required' question rather than reviewing the attached document. No fabrication, but no engagement with case-specific fields (correctly clean here, so no defect impact).

Claim text asserts validity requirements beyond the single quoted line ('requested only when marital status is married'). Rule is accurate to the corpus but the quote under-supports the fuller claim; document not substantively reviewed.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Add a mandatory defect checklist the Worker must evaluate against the actual document fields before answering: (1) civil_registration_status/marital_status contradictions — reject if status is 'single'/'unregistered' or notes say religious/customary ceremony not civilly registered (PFL-MARRIAGE-01); (2) name consistency — compare spouse_given/family_name and marriage_certificate name against passport_details, flag mismatch absent legal name-change proof (PFL-MARRIAGE-02); (3) physical_presence/marriage_location — reject proxy, virtual, videoconference, or tele-marriage solemnizations (PFL-MARRIAGE-03); (4) document_translation — reject uncertified/machine/self translations lacking translator affidavit or credentials for non-English/French certificates (PFL-MARRIAGE-04).

Require Workers to review the specific attached document and emit per-document defect findings (with affected fields) rather than returning a generic policy answer. A report that only restates the requirement rule without evaluating the document's fields and narrative notes must be treated as incomplete.

rationale: All 10 Worker reports (gemini-3.6-flash) returned near-identical boilerplate answering the generic 'what document is required' question, citing the completeness-check corpus rule, without reviewing the attached documents. Citations are consistent and plausibly resolve (citation_exactness 1.0); claims contain no fabricated applicant facts and no PII leaked into claims/prose — all applicant references stayed in basis[] (pii_containment 1.0); no ground-truth verdicts or failure IDs leaked (blind_input_compliance 1.0). Grounding is high but not perfect because several claims assert validity/jurisdiction requirements beyond their one-line quote and never engage document reality. The decisive failure is defect_recall: 0/8 injected defects detected — including glaring, explicit signals (marital status 'single' with 'unregistered' civil status, Takahashi/Kim name mismatch, physical presence 'False' proxy marriage, and uncertified machine translation). Both clean cases score defect_recall 1.0 vacuously (no defects present). The Worker is safe on PII/blindness but non-functional as a defect detector.
